## Problem and scope

Issue or direct-fix reproduction: <!-- Link the issue, or describe the correction; include a reproduction for a code fix. -->

What concrete problem does this solve? What does the user see after the change?

## Verification

Checks and results: <!-- Commands and OS/component for code; rendered-text review for docs, plus the repository check when links or assets change. -->

Known limits or checks not run:

Keep local tests, exact-head CI and actual provider execution distinct. Describe relevant failure/recovery checks for durable operations.

## UI evidence (if applicable)

Before/after screenshots using fictional data (result only for new UI); a short video/GIF of one changed interaction when practical. Include written steps and OS/version. Label mockups and remove private data, user paths, tokens and account identifiers.

## Submitter review

- [ ] I reviewed the entire diff, verified its claims and kept it within the described scope. AI-assisted work meets the same standard.
- [ ] Source, fixtures and attachments contain no private candidate data, credentials, session tokens, model weights or vendor runtime libraries.
